visual.general_description: Grayscale axial MRI slice through the orbits and posterior fossa with one white arrow.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale axial magnetic resonance image through both orbits, a dark central midline region, the temporal lobes, the brainstem and the cerebellum. The interior of both globes is dark, the orbital fat and soft tissues are grey, and bright fluid-like signal lines the posterior fossa and some sulcal spaces. One large white arrow with a head, drawn on the image, points up and to the left toward the posterior orbital region beside the nasal side of the globe on the right half of the image. No letters, laterality markers, scale bars, text, patient identifiers or dates are visible in the image.
